correctness.rationale: The exhaustive unique derivation block parametrization, wedge-square eigenvalue analysis, exact linear equations for central parameters, central-shear conjugation, and Gaussian complement count prove all orbit sizes and operator ranks over arbitrary finite fields. The proof treats both characteristics, all admissible r, and the zero map. Prime-field exhaustive matrix tests and a separately implemented GF(4) test match the formula; they are corroboration rather than proof.
